subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should OpenClaw keep fixing the bundled Himalaya skill docs now, or should the active bundled-skill trimming direction remove/externalize Himalaya and close this as superseded?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still expose stale bundled docs, but VISION.md and the open protected skill-trimming PR point toward moving optional skills out of core; automation should not choose that product boundary.

options.title: Resolve through skill trimming first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product-direction gate, then close this issue if Himalaya leaves core or patch docs only if it remains bundled.

options.title: Patch bundled docs now
options.body: Keep Himalaya in core for now and land a focused docs PR that fixes the copy-paste hazards against a named Himalaya version.

options.title: Publish outside core
options.body: Ask contributors to maintain Himalaya as a ClawHub skill/bundle and close the core issue once users have a clear external package path.

recommendation.title: Resolve through skill trimming first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product-direction gate, then close this issue if Himalaya leaves core or patch docs only if it remains bundled.

likelyOwner.reason: The active open PR by fuller-stack-dev is the current product-direction vehicle for removing Himalaya from the bundled skill set.
